purpose: Stage 2 drug-perturbation model candidate (deployed): DECANT mechanism/context-decoupled representation

sources.method: git clone <url> source/ && git -C source checkout <commit> && rm -rf source/.git

notes: Deployed model; the repository is a reproduction skeleton that explicitly excludes processed cell bags, teacher prototypes and checkpoints, so there is no public data file to download. Absorbed from the deleted VALIDATION.md: an earlier import-only check was too shallow; the in-repo Phase1MechanismTopologyModel instantiated at 2,000 genes with n_programs=50 accepts dose_log1p and its output changes with dose (dose effect L1 = 1.60e-2 between log1p(1) and log1p(100)). Caveats: it needs matched treated/control cell bags, dose is treated as context to suppress rather than a target response axis, and no processed data/checkpoints exist.
